name: NodePool_ReleaseNode
summary: Pushes a node onto the pool's free list at this+4 and decrements the live count at this+0x4000C (clamped at 0), guarded by a range check against the 65536-dword inline pool.
evidence: Links *a2=this[1]; this[1]=a2; this[65539]-- with clamp; range test against this+2..this+65537. Callers include MeshResourceMng_ResolveTree and CMoElemFamily_SharedCleanup. The range check compares *a2 rather than a2, so the exact guard semantics are unclear.

name: GetGlobal_1047D114
summary: Returns the global dword_1047D114.
evidence: Body is `return dword_1047D114;`. Callers include CMoGeneratorClone_FixupClonedPointers.

name: MoProcessor_CallVSlot49
summary: Forwards `this` to virtual slot 49 (+0xC4) of the g_pProcessor CMoProcessor singleton.
evidence: The only operation is g_pProcessor->vftable[49](g_pProcessor, this). It has 22 callers in CMo* element code (for example CMoDistMorphElem_ApplyMorph).

name: CMoTask_Constructor
summary: Stores the CMoTask vtable, then (unless byte_1047D13D is set) resets the fields and registers the task, and returns this.
evidence: Stores CMoTask_vtbl_ambiguous34 into *this and returns this. It calls sub_100748F0, which zeroes the fields, and sub_100749F0. It has 33 callers, including App_InitScene and StAvatar_SwitchMusicTask.

name: CMoTask_Destructor
summary: Restores the CMoTask vtable and calls sub_10074AD0(this,1), which unlinks the task.
evidence: Stores CMoTask_vtbl_ambiguous34, then makes the call. It is called from many ScalarDeletingDtors (CXiActorDraw, CAtelIdleTask, ...) and from CMoTaskMng_Destructor, which runs it on 64 embedded tasks.

name: CMoTask_ResetFields
summary: Zeroes the CMoTask fields at +4..+0x28 and copies the one-shot global flag byte_1047D13C into +0x20, then clears that global.
evidence: The body is a run of zero stores plus `*(this+32)=byte_1047D13C; byte_1047D13C=0`. CMoTask_Constructor calls it and it has 48 callers.

name: CMoTask_RegisterWithMng
summary: Passes this task and an argument to the task manager singleton dword_1047D140 through sub_10074F80, most likely to register or enqueue it.
evidence: Body: sub_10074F80(dword_1047D140, this, a2). dword_1047D140 is the manager that CMoTaskMng owns. It has 24 callers that construct tasks (App_InitScene, ...).

name: CMoTaskMng_Forward10075120
summary: Calls sub_10075120 on the task manager singleton dword_1047D140 with a1.
evidence: Body: sub_10075120(dword_1047D140, a1). Callers are CXiSkeletonActor_Constructor_Factory and sub_10074A00. The callee's purpose is unknown.

name: CMoTaskMng_Destructor
summary: Stores the CMoTaskMng vtable, frees the dynamically allocated task chain at +0xD50, then destroys the 64 embedded CMoTask slots in reverse order.
evidence: Stores CMoTaskMng_vtbl. It walks the list at +852*4 via next pointer +12 calling sub_10074AB0, then loops 64 times with stride 13 dwords calling CMoTask_Destructor (sub_100747C0). Its only caller is CMoTaskMng_ScalarDeletingDtor.

name: Gfx_InitCubeMapTextures
summary: Creates render-target cube textures of size 32<<i (3 sizes), then clears each face except one by drawing a screen quad into it.
evidence: Calls Device vtbl+200 SetRenderState for ALPHABLEND(27), ZWRITE(14), ZENABLE(7) and ALPHATEST(15) off, and CULLMODE(22)=NONE. Calls vtbl+88 CreateCubeTexture(32<<i, 1 level, USAGE_RENDERTARGET, backbuffer format from surface GetDesc) into dword_1047D15C[i], and cube vtbl+60 GetCubeMapSurface per face from dword_103546A0 (skips 5). Then SetVertexShader(0x44 XYZRHW|DIFFUSE) and CDx_DrawPrimitiveUP(TRIANGLESTRIP, 2).

name: TexRef_ResolveByName
summary: Resolves a texture reference by name: it looks the name up in g_pTextureMng (sub_1003AF10), and if that misses it scans the manager's list for an entry whose 8-byte name matches this+8..+15, then stores the found handle in *this.
evidence: Calls sub_1003AF10(g_pTextureMng, this, a2). The fallback walks the list via next +0x38 and tests flags +0x2C&0x100 or +0x34==1. It compares 8 name bytes and writes *(this)=result. IDA's 'type_info::raw_name' callee is a misidentified list-head getter.

name: TexRef_EnsureRenderTarget
summary: Makes sure a cached CAcc render-target helper (dword_1047D158) matches the width and height (+36/+38) of the referenced texture. If the size differs, it releases the helper and recreates it with a surface from sub_1006A150 and an object from sub_1000AD70.
evidence: Compares the texture's u16 +36/+38 with the globals dword_1047D200/dword_1047D150. It calls CAcc_Constructor on a 16-byte allocation, then sub_1006A150(g_pResourceMng,w,h,&out) and sub_1000AD70(g_pCDx,w,h). Unit unit_10074CA0 is shared with Gfx_InitCubeMapTextures.

name: TexRef_SetTexture
summary: Binds the referenced texture (the D3D texture at +64, falling back to +68) to texture stage a2, or binds NULL when the reference is empty.
evidence: Calls Device vtbl+244 (=SetTexture, index 61) with (a2, tex). The same +64/+68 texture-pointer pattern appears in Font_BindGlyphTexture. It has 7 callers.

name: ActorHandle_Constructor
summary: Initializes a small handle object: stores vtable off_1032CF5C, clears +4, keeps the top byte of +8 and sets byte +11 to 4.
evidence: Stores the vtable and returns this. Its callers include ActorHandle_Resolve, and it shares the off_1032CF5C vtable with sub_100814E0. The class name is inferred from callers.

name: ActorHandle_Destructor
summary: Restores the off_1032CF5C vtable (an empty destructor body).
evidence: Body: `*this=&off_1032CF5C`. Callers include ReleaseSubObjectIfPresent, ActorHandle_Resolve and CXiControlActor_Destructor (on this+360).

name: Actor_ResetDrawLists
summary: Resets the actor draw-list head, the update-bucket counters and related globals (one is set to 50), and clears the actor handle at dword_1047D600.
evidence: Writes g_pActorDrawListHead=0, g_actorUpdateBucketCountA/B=0 and dword_1048A354=50, and calls sub_100814F0(dword_1047D600,0).

name: Actor_UnlinkAllAttachLists
summary: Empties two intrusive lists at +0x68 and +0x6C by repeatedly unlinking the head (sub_1003B5E0 / sub_1003B610) until each is null.
evidence: Loops `for(i=this[26];i;i=this[26]) sub_1003B5E0(i)` and the same for this[27]. Callers include CXiSkeletonActor_DestructorBody. CXiActor_KillGeneratorClones walks the same two lists to find generator clones.

name: CXiActor_IsModelMissingOrFlag2000
summary: Returns true when the actor has no model data at +0x70, or when that data's flags at +0x120 have bit 0x2000 set.
evidence: Body: `v=this[28]; return !v || (v[288]&0x2000)`. Callers include the CXiSkeletonActor constructors and sub_10083430.

name: CXiActor_ModelTest95790
summary: If model data (+0x70) exists, forwards a2 to sub_10095790 on it and returns the bool; otherwise returns false.
evidence: Null-guarded forward of this[28]. In CXiSkeletonActor head-look code it is called as Test(GetMotionId()) next to the motion-id checks.

name: CXiActor_ModelTest95680
summary: If model data (+0x70) exists, forwards a2 to sub_10095680 on it and returns the bool; otherwise returns false.
evidence: Null-guarded forward of this[28]. It has 19 callers, including CXiSkeletonActor_OnMove.

name: CXiActor_ModelTest956A0
summary: If model data (+0x70) exists, forwards a2 to sub_100956A0 on it and returns the bool; otherwise returns false.
evidence: Null-guarded forward of this[28]. It has 23 callers, including CXiSkeletonActor_OnMove.

name: CXiActor_GetModelField170
summary: Returns the dword at model+0x170, or the default dword_1047D60C when there is no model.
evidence: Body: `v=this[28]; return v ? *(v+368) : dword_1047D60C`. It has 38 callers. The head-look code compares the value against 47/48 (a motion or state id).

name: CXiActor_HasNonzeroField150or158
summary: Returns true when model(+0x70)->+0xD4->+0x260 has a nonzero float at +0x150 or +0x158.
evidence: Follows a three-level pointer chain and tests two floats. Its only caller is PerActor_FourBucketStaggeredUpdate. The fields probably encode movement, but that is not proven.

name: CXiActor_GetModelByteEE
summary: Returns the signed byte at model+0xEE, or the default dword_1047D610 when there is no model.
evidence: Body: `v=this[28]; return v ? (char)*(v+238) : dword_1047D610`. It has 31 callers. Head-look code treats the value as a category (0,1,2,6,7,8).

name: CXiActor_GetModelByteEF
summary: Returns a byte that comes from virtual +956 when virtual +948 says so, otherwise from model+0xEF, otherwise the default dword_1047D614.
evidence: Calls vtbl+948 as the override test, then vtbl+956, then (char)*(this[28]+239). Callers include CXiSkeletonActor_SetModel. The value 5/6 triggers a 0.8 scale in sub_100C5440.

name: CXiActor_GetModelPartWord
summary: Returns the u16 part id for slot a2: from virtual +964 when virtual +948 says so, otherwise model+0xFC[a2], otherwise the default (a2<<12)|table[a2].
evidence: The default value encodes the slot index in its top nibble. Callers include CXiSkeletonActor_LoadSkeletonSync and CXiSkeletonActor_IsReadCompleteBody.

name: CXiActor_GetModelFlags120Top2
summary: Returns bits 30-31 of model+0x120, or 1 when there is no model.
evidence: Body: `v ? *(v+288)>>30 : 1`. Callers are CXiSkeletonActor_SetModel and sub_100CF750.

name: CXiActor_GetModelFlags130Top2
summary: Returns bits 30-31 of model+0x130, or 0 when there is no model.
evidence: Body: `v ? *(v+304)>>30 : 0`. Callers are CXiSkeletonActor_SetModel and sub_100CF750.

name: CXiActor_GetModelFloat9AEC0
summary: Returns sub_1009AEC0(model) as a double, or 0.0 when there is no model.
evidence: Null-guarded forward of this[28]. Callers include CXiSkeletonActor_SetModel.

name: CXiActor_IsModelMissingOrSuppressed
summary: Returns true when there is no model, when actor byte +0x88 has bit 8 set, or when model+0x128 has bit 0x10 set.
evidence: Three-way flag test. Callers are PerActor_FourBucketStaggeredUpdate and sub_10083430.

name: CXiActor_TestModelFlag128_8
summary: Returns model+0x128 bit 8, or, when there is no model, whether byte +9 of g_pCamera is nonzero.
evidence: Callers are CXiSkeletonActor_OnDrawName and PerActor_FourBucketStaggeredUpdate.

name: CXiActor_TestModelFlags100000_200000_4000
summary: Returns true when model data exists and has flag 0x100000 or 0x200000 at +0x120, or flag 0x4000 at +0x128.
evidence: Pure flag test. Its only caller is PerActor_FourBucketStaggeredUpdate.

name: CXiActor_GetModelByte1DB
summary: Returns the unsigned byte at model+0x1DB, or 0 when there is no model.
evidence: Body: `v ? *(u8*)(v+475) : 0`. Callers are CXiSkeletonActor_LoadSkeletonSync and CXiSkeletonActor_GetElem.

name: CXiActor_SpawnResourceGenerators
summary: Unless the actor is suppressed (vfunc+292 or flag +178&2), it walks the actor's type-5 resources. For each one of the listed kinds with flag 0x1000 at +216 it calls sub_10053A00, then collects up to 128 of them and creates a CMoGeneratorClone instance for each.
evidence: Calls ResourceIter_FindFirst(…,5,0,-1)/FindNext twice, then sub_10053A00(res,this,…) and CMoGeneratorClone_CreateInstance(res,this,0,1). The body has no D3D or draw calls. That contradicts the DancingMad label 'CXiActor_DrawResourceShadows' (author-inferred, describing DrawIndexedPrimitiveUP), even though one caller is named CXiSkeletonActor_DrawResourceShadows.

name: CXiActor_IsInModelSlotTable
summary: Returns true when this actor pointer appears in any of the 12 actor slots at model+0xA4..+0xD0.
evidence: Compares v1[41]..v1[52] against this. Callers include CXiSkeletonActor_GetEnglishName and CXiSkeletonActor_OnMove.

name: CXiActor_KillGeneratorClones
summary: Walks the actor's two attachment lists (+0x68 and +0x6C). For each entry whose owner (vfunc+24) is a CMoGeneratorClone that sub_100539E0 does not flag, it kills the clone (sub_100543A0) and restarts the scan.
evidence: Calls CYyObject_IsKindOf(obj, &CMoGeneratorClone_classdesc) and sub_100543A0. Its only caller is CXiSkeletonActor_KillAllGenerater.

name: Actor_DrawWorldText
summary: Draws a text string at a 3D position. It sets the world transform from matrix a1, projects the point, culls it if it falls more than 100px off-screen, scales by viewport/426.7*a3, expands special glyph codes 0xC8-0xCD, measures the glyphs through the font (sub_10120510 on dword_104E1BF8) and draws the quads with DrawPrimitiveUP.
evidence: Calls CDx_SetTransform(256 = D3DTS_WORLD), Camera_GetViewportWidth/Height (+100 margin) and CDx_DrawPrimitiveUP. The 0.0023437501 factor equals 1/426.67 and the string is clamped to 36 chars. Its callers are CXiSkeletonActor's name-draw wrapper (sub_100D0880) and sub_10174EC0.

name: Call1008A0E0With2
summary: Calls sub_1008A0E0(2).
evidence: Body: `return sub_1008A0E0(2);`. Its only caller is sub_10013AD0.

name: Unit10086E90_ResetGlobals
summary: Bulk-resets a large set of module globals (tables, flags, counters; some set to 600, 0x7F007F or -1), runs a series of sub-resets and then calls sub_101C80C0(dword_10489948, sub_1025B560(37)).
evidence: The body is mostly memset and zero stores, plus calls to sub_10093A30..sub_10093B50, sub_100A3CD0 and sub_1015D860. It clears dword_10480AF0, the table read by Entity_GetIndexedPtr. The subsystem cannot be pinned from this evidence.

name: Net_SendPacket00COnce
summary: On first call (gated by dword_104859E4) it allocates a 12-byte outgoing packet with header 0x060C (id 0x00C, size 3 dwords), clears the gate and sets several ready flags, then calls sub_10097FD0(0,0).
evidence: sub_100FC3C0(12,0,0) returns a buffer and the code writes header word 1548=0x060C. It sets dword_1047D3F0=1. It is called from the CXiSkeletonActor constructors. Reading this as a network packet is inferred from the header shape.

name: Entity_BuildDisplayName
summary: Builds the display name in the static buffer byte_104855B0: up to 2 prefix icon chars plus status chars, a space, and then the name from +532 (or +124 when the u16 +528 is 0) via strncat(…,128). It also sets the name colour at (+160)->+124 (0x80808080, or +468 when the prefix is 0x92).
evidence: Calls sub_10097500 and sub_10097730 for prefix chars and _strncat. Its only caller is CXiSkeletonActor_GetEnglishName.

name: Entity_GetIndexedPtr
summary: Returns dword_10480AF0[u16 at +0x2A2], or 0 when the index is 0.
evidence: Body: `idx=this[337]; return idx ? dword_10480AF0[idx] : 0`. Callers include CXiSkeletonActor_OnDrawName and CXiSkeletonActor_OnMove.

name: Entity_IsModelIdB22toB31
summary: Returns true when the u16 at +0xFC is in the range 0xB22..0xB31.
evidence: Range compare only. Callers are CXiSkeletonActor_OnDrawName and sub_10202960.

name: CMoTask_VT_1032D6D4_Destructor
summary: Destructor for a CMoTask subclass: stores vtable CMoTask_vtbl_ambiguous35, marks byte +1 of the linked object at +0x48 as 0xFF if it is 0, clears the singleton dword_10487F08 when it points to this, and then runs CMoTask_Destructor.
evidence: Stores the vtable, then the code tail-calls sub_100747C0. Its only caller is CMoTask_VT_1032D6D4_ScalarDeletingDtor.

name: CXiCollisionActor_Constructor
summary: Builds the CXiControlActor base, stores the CXiCollisionActor vtable and initializes collision fields, including two random 0..119 timers and an orientation (0,-1,0,1) at +0x160.
evidence: Calls CXiControlActor_Constructor, stores CXiCollisionActor_vtbl_ambiguous0, calls rand()%120 twice and sub_10026E30(this+88, 0,-1,0,1). It is called from the CXiSkeletonActor constructors as a base ctor.

name: CXiControlActor_Destructor
summary: Stores the CXiControlActor vtable, destroys the embedded ActorHandle at +0x5A0 and then runs the base destructor (sub_10082B40).
evidence: Callers are CXiControlActor_ScalarDeletingDtor and CXiCollisionActor_ScalarDeletingDtor.

name: CMoTask_VT_1032E808_Destructor
summary: Destructor for a CMoTask subclass: deletes the owned CXiSchStatus at +0x7C, releases the embedded CMoAttachments sub-object at +0x34 and then runs CMoTask_Destructor.
evidence: Stores CMoTask_vtbl_ambiguous36 and CMoAttachments_vtbl_ambiguous27, then calls CXiSchStatus_Destructor + operator_delete and ReleaseSubObjectIfPresent. Its only caller is CMoTask_VT_1032E808_ScalarDeletingDtor.

summary: Resolves the actor handle dword_1047D600, calls its virtual +820 with 1 and clears the global dword_10456DAC.
evidence: There are no callers, so it is probably a callback or vtable entry. Callees: ActorHandle_Resolve and vfunc+820(1). Its purpose cannot be pinned.

summary: Resolves the actor at dword_1047D600 and calls its virtual +820(0). It then picks the current target (sub_10157CF0 or sub_10081600) and calls the target's virtual +1016. If the actor's GetModelByteEF is 5 or 6 it scales the global float dword_10456DA8 by 0.8, and it sets dword_10456DAC=0.
evidence: It is twin to sub_100C54C0, which differs only in setting dword_10456DAC=5.0f. There are no callers, so it is probably a callback.

summary: Same as sub_100C5440, except that it sets the global dword_10456DAC to 5.0f (0x40A00000) instead of 0.
evidence: Twin of sub_100C5440. There are no callers, so it is probably a callback or table entry.

name: Actor_SelectNearestLights
summary: Picks up to 4 of the actor's 5 candidate lights. It ranks point lights by 1/(dist^2*atten) and blends directional lights toward their targets, then copies the chosen D3DLIGHT8 records into g_lightTable. Point lights are converted to directional lights pointing from the light to the actor and scaled by their weight.
evidence: Uses 0x68-byte (sizeof D3DLIGHT8) records with a stride of 104, Type==1 (POINT) changed to 3 (DIRECTIONAL), qmemcpy 0x68 into g_lightTable_Start, and the actor position from vfunc+444. Calls XiZone_GetAmbient and XiZone_GetFog. Its only caller is PerActor_FourBucketStaggeredUpdate.

summary: If vfunc+340 returns true, it reads two joint or point positions (ids 23 and 24) and a matrix (id 28) from the actor, writes them into the object returned by sub_10015250 (+140/+152 with flags +136..138), and passes an angle (x*60 degrees in radians) and a scaled value (y*200) on to sub_10015290.
evidence: Calls vfunc+452(23/24) and vfunc+464(28), Vec3_Copy and 0.017453292 (deg→rad). Its only caller is PerActor_FourBucketStaggeredUpdate. It looks like an actor-driven camera parameter, but the target object is unidentified.

name: CXiSkeletonActor_DrawNameIfVisible
summary: Calls Actor_DrawWorldText(a2..a6) unless the actor's u16 at +0xB2 is nonzero.
evidence: Guarded forward to sub_10086210. Its only caller is CXiSkeletonActor_OnDrawName.

name: CXiSkeletonActor_DrawName2IfVisible
summary: Calls sub_10086900(a2,a3,a4), the 3-argument text-draw variant, unless the actor's u16 at +0xB2 is nonzero.
evidence: Guarded forward. Its only caller is CXiSkeletonActor_OnDrawName.

name: CXiSkeletonActor_DeleteOwnedList
summary: Walks the owned list at +0x7E4, unlinking each node (sub_1002C800) and deleting it through its virtual slot +24 with argument 1 (deleting destructor).
evidence: Its only caller is CXiSkeletonActor_DestructorBody.

name: CXiSkeletonActor_CalcGroundTiltMatrix
summary: Builds a smoothed orientation matrix in a2. It takes the ground normal (vfunc+528), clamps it to within 30 degrees of up (0,-1,0), blends it by this[522] and over time by a3 into this[523], and combines it with the actor yaw (vfunc+448). The tilt weight this[522] then comes from the aspect ratio of the bounding extents (vfunc+968).
evidence: Uses a cos30 test (0.86602539), a 0.52359879 (30°) rotation clamp, the up vector (0,-1,0,1) and cross products/normalize (sub_10027550/sub_100274B0). The 1.4/0.6 aspect thresholds pick the axis from dword_1035F5F0/F5E4. Its only caller is PerActor_FourBucketStaggeredUpdate.

name: CXiSkeletonActor_UpdateHeadLook
summary: Chooses a look-at target (the current target or sub_100845E0) when the actor's motion and category allow it. It takes joint 3 of the target (lowered by 1.2 when target+0xB2 is set), and ramps a look weight at controller+188 up or down at about 0.04 per step depending on whether the target is in front and near.
evidence: Calls vfunc+452(3) on the target, uses CXiActor_GetModelField170 checks (0/47/48) and the ModelTest helpers, and checks GetModelByteEF in {0,1,2,6,7,8}. It works in yaw space (sub_10027BD0) and resets to dword_1035F5FC.. when the weight drops below 0. Its only caller is PerActor_FourBucketStaggeredUpdate.

name: Actor_PrepareDrawGlobals
summary: Lazily caches the actor's per-draw resources: a texture named by off_1035F60C, and resources of kind 10/'evev', 94 and 10/'ohno' via vfunc+492, recorded by flags in +0x840. It then publishes them and other per-actor values (light count, colour 0x80808080-style) into globals used by the draw path.
evidence: Calls sub_1003AF10(g_pTextureMng, off_1035F60C, …) and uses FourCCs 0x76657665/0x6F6E686F. It writes g_lightTable_End=this[465] and dword_104574B4=(0x80000000-alpha)|0x808080. Its only caller is PerActor_FourBucketStaggeredUpdate.

name: GameMode_GetField98
summary: Returns the dword at +0x98 (the mode or enabled field tested by GameMode_RequestState).
evidence: Body: `return this[38];`.

name: GameMode_PollPendingState
summary: Returns 100 when no state change is pending (+0x90==100). Otherwise it returns 101 if the requested state (+0x8C) is negative, or copies the requested state into +0x14 and returns it.
evidence: Field +0x90 is set to 100 by GameMode_RequestState. Callers include Frame_Render and the GameMode_OpenTacticsUrl helper.

name: GameMode_RequestState
summary: State machine transition: validates request a2 against the current state (+0x88) using per-state allowed-predecessor sets. It records the new state and parameter a3 (+0x80 or +0x84), clears the pending marker (+0x90=100) and resets the +0xC timer. An invalid request recurses into error state 201.
evidence: A switch over states 0..23 and 201..203, with the fallback `this[37]=201; sub_100DB170(this,201,0)`. It has 10 callers, including sub_10013DF0. Calling the owner object a game mode is inferred.

name: GameMode_OpenTacticsUrl
summary: Formats a POL 'ffxi.tactics' web URL from 17 fields of record a2 (or a fixed URL when a2 is null) and hands it to sub_10017630 to open.
evidence: String: "http://wh000.pol.com/polapps/s/ffxi.tactics?a=%s&b=%s&c=%d…" passed through sprintf. It is gated on GameMode_PollPendingState()!=100.

name: Gfx_ApplyViewport1B70
summary: Applies the saved viewport g_viewport_1B70 through CDx_SetViewport.
evidence: Body: `return CDx_SetViewport(g_pCDx, &g_viewport_1B70);`.

name: Font_BindGlyphTexture
summary: Lazily looks up the 'FontMoji' font texture into +0x74 (and the high-res variant at +0x78 via sub_1011C720 when +0x80==1), then binds the active one to texture stage 0.
evidence: String aFontMoji is passed to sub_1003AC80(g_pTextureMng) and followed by Device SetTexture(0, tex(+64 or +68)). Callers are the font draw routines (Font_DrawChar, Obj_104E1B90_DrawString).

name: Font_DrawGlyphQuad
summary: Fills a 4-vertex screen quad for glyph code a2 from a 64x128 glyph grid (UV steps 1/64, 1/128), sized 16*a5 by 16*a6 at position a3 and tinted by colour a4. It draws the quad as a 2-triangle strip and then restores the vertex colours.
evidence: Uses UV 0.015625/0.0078125, SetVertexShader(324=0x144 XYZRHW|DIFFUSE|TEX1) and CDx_DrawPrimitiveUP(5 = TRIANGLESTRIP, 2, stride 28), with -0.5 pixel offsets.

name: Gfx_SetAdditiveBlend
summary: Enables additive alpha blending (ONE, ONE).
evidence: Sets D3DRS_ALPHABLENDENABLE=1, D3DRS_SRCBLEND=2 (ONE) and D3DRS_DESTBLEND=2 (ONE).

name: Font_DrawChar
summary: Sets the vertex colour of the shared font quad. Codes >= 0x2115 (8469..8515) are drawn as icon sprites from table dword_10621934 (sub_1011FB60), after which additive blend and the glyph texture are restored. Other codes are drawn as glyph quads at the cursor dword_104E1B88/8C.
evidence: Writes colour into the vertices of dword_104E1B90 (+16/+44/+72/+100), then calls Gfx_SetAdditiveBlend + Font_BindGlyphTexture and sub_1011BBA0 (the Font_DrawGlyphQuad wrapper).

name: Obj_104E1B90_DrawString
summary: Draws a string: it sets the blend mode from flag bits of a6, positions the cursor at (a1,a2), and loops over the characters (decoding with sub_1011CE80) to draw each with Font_DrawChar, advancing by the scaled glyph width. Afterwards it resets the vertex colours to 0x80808080, sets ALPHAOP=5 and disables alpha blending.
evidence: Calls sub_1011C1F0 (Gfx_SetCellBlendMode), Gfx_SetAdditiveBlend, Font_BindGlyphTexture, sub_1011D840 (glyph width) and sub_1011BF40. It ends with SetTextureStageState(0, D3DTSS_ALPHAOP, 5 MODULATE) and ALPHABLENDENABLE 0.

name: Gfx_SetCellBlendMode
summary: Sets the alpha-blend state for a 'cell' compositing mode chosen by three 2-bit selectors (zero/frame/texture combos). It programs SRCBLEND/DESTBLEND/BLENDOP and logs unsupported combos by name.
